mapper.select: SELECT no,bno,id,name,msg, TO_CHAR(regdate,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as dbday, group_tab FROM mvcBoardReply WHERE bno=#{bno} ORDER BY group_id DESC, group_step ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mvcBoardReply(no,bno,id,name,msg,group_id) VALUES(mr_no_seq.nextval, #{bno}, #{id}, #{name}, #{msg}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(group_id)+1,1) FROM mvcBoardReply) )
INSERT INTO mvcBoardReply(no, bno, id, name, msg, group_id, group_step, group_tab, root) VALUES(mr_no_seq.nextval, #{bno}, #{id}, #{name}, #{msg}, #{group_id}, #{group_step}, #{group_tab}, #{root})
